title: a cell that the table names twice is named a duplicate and not an absent cell
intent: The wave that repairs the proof of the track D (the wave D1) for the third time: the discriminator of the package of the waves 87 to 89 named one finding that touches it (F26).  The code of the kernel and the generator are honest; the proof was weaker than the promise.  The wave touches no code of the kernel and no file of the generator.  (1) **The comparison reported a duplicate cell as an absent cell**: the table of the machine named one cell twice, the diagram carried one arrow for the two cells, and the comparison fell out of its own branches into `report_absent' -- so the check answered with the false subject "the generator does not read the table", while the generator read the table and the table said one thing about one event twice.  A false refusal with a false subject is worse than no refusal: it sends the reader to the generator, and the defect is in the table.  (2) **The comparison now tells the cases apart**: it counts the cells that the table names the same (`c_same'), the arrows that the diagram carries for such a cell (`c_arrows'), and the arrows that the diagram repeats (`a_same'), and the defect has a subject of its own -- `twice' (the table of the machine names the same cell more than once and the diagram carries fewer arrows for it than the table names cells) and `twice-arrow' (the diagram carries the same arrow more than once and the cell of the table has no arrow of its own).  The subjects of wave 87 (`absent', `leads', `label') are kept where they are true.  (3) **The check proves this on itself**: a copy of the kernel whose table names the same cell twice is compared with the diagram of the repository -- the diagram of the repository on purpose, so that the control reads the comparison and not the health of the generator -- and the comparison must name the duplicate and must not call the cell an absent one.  The words of the messages live in one place now (`problem_message'), and the comparison can be read instead of only judged (`compare_cells' with the mode `print'), which is what the control of the wave needs.
objection: The claim is about a proof and not about a picture of the site: the check compares the cells of the table with the arrows of the diagram, and the pictures of the site itself are the waves D3 and D4.  The price is named and it is three prices.  (a) **The check does not forbid the duplicate in the table itself**: a table that names a cell twice and a diagram that carries that arrow twice are green here -- the generator draws one arrow for every cell, so such a diagram is the correct drawing of such a table.  The duplicate is forbidden in the place where it belongs: the machine has a unit test of its own (`yeah-loop-no-label-is-declared-twice-for-one-state', tests/unit/test-yeah-loop.el), and the runtime takes the first match, so the second row is dead weight.  The wave says where the class is closed and does not pretend to close it twice.  (b) **A new subject is a new thing to read**: when the diagram repeats an arrow, the cell that the diagram does not carry is named `twice-arrow' and not "the generator does not read the table"; the message is true in both halves -- the arrow is repeated and the cell is not in the diagram -- but the reader has to look at the repeated arrow as well.  (c) The comparison goes by content and not by order: the order of the arrows is not measured, and the objection (c) of wave 87 stands.  Two more objections of wave 87 stand as well: the rule of the identifier of PlantUML is written twice (in the generator and in the check) and the pipeline in a tree without the kernel is measured only in the case "no kernel" (the answer 3) and not in the case "the generator answered 1".
refuted_by: the diagram of the repository is not the file that the generator writes from the current code, or the generator does not read the table of the machine, or the generator does not read the list of the states, or the diagram does not carry every cell and every state of the machine, or an arrow of the diagram carries ends that are not the ends of its cell, or a cell that the table names twice is called an absent cell, or the pipeline does not draw the machine in both themes, or the pipeline answers with the code 0 when the machine cannot be generated, or the pipeline draws a picture when the generation of the machine failed, or the control of the claim does not make the check fail by its own assertion
note: The claim of the wave is amended and not rewritten: the id `the-state-diagram-comes-from-the-code' is the same, the text says that a cell which the table names twice is named a duplicate and not an absent cell; the `falsifier' names the new refusal, and the `control' is the same.  Twelve controls were applied to copies of the tree on 2026-11-20 -- seven by the writer of the wave and five more by the parent, and the parent's five were made independently of the report of the writer.  Every one of them ended with the verdict the control asked for.  (1) The honest tree -- the code 0, in 3.3 seconds.  (2) **The unit control of the finding**: the comparison program is fed a file of cells with two identical cells and a diagram with one arrow.  Before the wave it answered `count 1 2' and `absent idle user-prompt deciding'; now it answers `count 1 2' and `twice idle user-prompt deciding 2 1'.  (3) **The old comparison program inside the new check** -- the code 1, with the two refusals of the new section: "the comparison of the cells does not tell a duplicate from an absent cell" and "the comparison of the cells calls the cell that the table of the machine names twice an absent cell".  The path of the duplicate is therefore measured and not a comment.  (4) The control of the claim -- the table is changed and the diagram is not written again -- the code 1.  (5) The control of wave 87 (F21) -- the generator leads the cell elsewhere -- the code 1 with the subject "the generator reads the table but leads the cell elsewhere" and not with the subject "the generator does not read the table".  The writer's own controls add the following: the guard of the check itself is broken by returning the branch of the duplicate to the branch of the absent cell -- the code 1 with the refusal of the new section; and the unit test of the machine on a table with a duplicate fails (`yeah-loop-no-label-is-declared-twice-for-one-state'), which is where the duplicate is forbidden.  The measurement of the wave: the file of the check grew by 180 lines and lost 25 (the file of the wave 87 check is 607 lines), and it goes in 3.3 seconds; the files of the kernel and of the generator were not touched by this wave.
